topic: 5 things to know about Character.AI's bankruptcy (and Disney's $20M bid)
post:
One of the hottest AI startups of the ChatGPT era just filed for bankruptcy. 📉
And Disney may walk away with part of it for $20 million.

Character.AI, the chatbot app where people talk to AI characters, filed for Chapter 11.

5 things you need to know 👇

1️⃣ It filed on October 12
The operating company, Character Technologies, filed in Delaware bankruptcy court.

2️⃣ Disney is the opening bidder at $20M
It's a "stalking horse" bid: a floor price other buyers can top. It covers a license to some of the company's intellectual property, not the whole company.

3️⃣ The numbers are small for a former AI darling
The filing lists assets and liabilities each between $50M and $100M.

4️⃣ The app is still running, for now
A sale is expected around late November or early December. Without a buyer, the platform could shut down.

5️⃣ The backstory matters
In 2024, its founders and many staff joined Google in a $2.7B deal. Disney also sent it a cease-and-desist over its characters in 2025.

Why it matters 💡
The AI boom has winners and losers. Great products can still fail when the team, the tech and the business model drift apart.

Practical takeaway:
If your work depends on a small AI tool, know how to export your data and have a backup option.
